title: Packages
description: Keep your parcels in Hyper+Space, on its page and in the menu bar: type a tracking number and a name, and Return on it opens its tracking page (the carrier's own when the number shows which, else 17track's, which finds it; opening sends the number to that site). Mark it delivered and it moves to Delivered. The menu bar item, and its widget in Pilot's dock, show how many are on the way. With your own TrackingMore API key (its paid plans) each parcel also gets its carrier found, its status, its last event and every event, and Delivered on its own; each new parcel takes one credit, refreshing none, at most every 15 minutes.
examples: Hyper+Space › Packages, type LX123456789CN shoes and press Return: kept as shoes, and Return on it opens its tracking page
Type track 1Z999AA10123456784 in Hyper+Space and press Return: Packages keeps it in one step, and the menu bar shows 📦 1

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: TrackingMore API key
preferences.description: Optional: without it Packages keeps your parcels and opens their tracking pages, and you mark them delivered. With it, live status and events from TrackingMore: its paid plans include a key (Developer › API Key › Generate API key), free accounts have none. Kept in the Keychain. Each new parcel uses one credit of your plan; refreshing uses none, at most every 15 minutes while one is on its way.
